leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the PKCE code verifier and challenge generation in an Angular service
Configure Angular routing to handle OAuth2 authorization code redirects
Construct HTTP requests to the authorization server with required PKCE parameters
Integrate token exchange logic to swap authorization codes for access tokens
Initialize and manage authentication state using Angular services
Apply route guards to protect application routes based on authentication status
Manipulate HTTP interceptors to attach access tokens to outgoing API requests
lessonTitle: OAuth2 PKCE Flow in a SPA
